thread:
alex: Heads-up — nightly eval triggered a fairly large quality regression for the summarization prompt set after the precision profile roll yesterday. ROUGE-L dropped ~7 pts and hallucination rate jumped.

eval-bot: nightly-eval | model=redwood-3b | profile=precision-fast-v3 | dataset=eval/summarize/top1k | ROUGE-L: 42.1 -> 35.2 (-6.9) | Hallucination-rate: 2.8% -> 9.4% | examples-diff-url: https://internal/redwood/evals/1832765123/diff

maria: Oof. Who pushed precision-fast-v3 live? @sahil? :eyes:

sahil: Yup, that was my change — switched hosted default from precision-stable-v2 -> precision-fast-v3 to shave latency. I validated on unit prompts but didn't run the full nightly eval. My bad. :grimacing:

alex: Can you paste the exact profile config you applied? Need to see quant type / calibration set.

sahil: config snippet:
```
{
  "profile_name": "precision-fast-v3",
  "quantization": "int8",
  "strategy": "per-channel",
  "calibration_dataset": "calib/fast-500",
  "symmetric": false,
  "clip_threshold": 0.995
}
```

clare: Reproduced locally with the same profile (ran nightly-eval local subset). Same ROUGE drop. Quick logs show calibration scale shift on key layers: layer_8 scale changed 0.87 -> 0.64, layer_12 0.92 -> 0.70. Also see more frequent token-unk spikes in early decoding.

maria: So this isn't FP8 — it's an INT8 per-channel config with a much smaller calibration set. That stands out. previous stable profile used calib/clean-10k right?

eval-bot: calib-history | profile=precision-stable-v2 -> calibration_dataset=calib/clean-10k | profile=precision-fast-v3 -> calibration_dataset=calib/fast-500

sahil: I picked fast-500 to speed gating for rollout. I thought per-channel would be enough to preserve accuracy. I underestimated distribution mismatch.

alex: OK — immediate plan: 1) rollback hosted default to precision-stable-v2, 2) pin dedicated customers, 3) disable auto-rollout of profiles, 4) run targeted diagnostics (per-layer KL, logit-topk cosine, sample diffs). Anyone object?

sahil: No objections. I'll rollback now and post a deploy note.

clare: Repro notes and quick commands I used:
```
# run the small repro set
./bin/quant-run --model redwood-3b --profile precision-fast-v3 --dataset eval/summarize/200 --seed 42 --out repro/183276
# compute per-layer kl and logit diffs
python tools/compare_activations.py --base-profile precision-stable-v2 --new-profile precision-fast-v3 --model redwood-3b --layers 1-24 --out diag/183276
```

clare: small sample diffs (from repro/183276/samples.txt):
```
BASE: "In summary, the court concluded that..."
NEW : "The judge said the case was dismissed due to..."  <-- factual shift / hallucination
BASE: "Key benefit is lower latency for small requests."
NEW : "Key benefit is lower throughput for small requests."  <-- contradicton
```

maria: Can we confirm whether the calibration set (fast-500) overlaps with training or eval data? That can bias quant scales.

eval-bot: calibration-audit | fast-500 -> overlap-with-eval: 12 items (~2.4%), overlap-with-train: 0 items

alex: 2.4% overlap isn't huge, but sample diversity is small. Per-channel int8 can be brittle with narrow calib sets. We should add automated KL threshold checks during profile publish.

sahil: Rollback done: host default set back to precision-stable-v2 at 1832765250. I'll follow up with a canary plan before reintroducing fast-v3.

clare: After rollback, reran the same subset: ROUGE-L back to 42.0, hallucination 3.1% — close to baseline.

maria: Good. Next steps: sahil to open GH issue in eng-ml/quant-profiles with labels [incident/regression, quantization], include repro artifacts and diff link. clare to run deeper diagnostics (per-layer distribution plots, topk-logit histograms, calibration curve). alex to add a gating check to the profile publish pipeline: require full nightly-eval pass or a KL/divergence metric threshold.

sahil: I'll create the issue now and include the revert PR in the description.

alex: Also: add a short checklist for future fast profiles: minimal calibration size (>=2k diverse), holdout eval coverage (summarize/qa/longform), canary rollout to <5% traffic, automated per-layer drift alerts.

maria: I'll own the gating policy design with product/console folks — want it in time for next rollout.

clare: Uploading diag plots and repro artifacts: https://internal/redwood/diag/183276_plots.zip

alex: Thanks. Good catch everyone. Keep the thread updated with the GH issue number and any further regression signals.

sahil: GH issue created: eng-ml/quant-profiles#482 — added repro, diff, revert PR link, and action items. Will coordinate follow-ups. :thumbsup:
